checks.name: EDR agent healthy on every endpoint
checks.remediation: Reinstall or repair the sensor on degraded endpoints and confirm prevention is on.

checks.name: Disk encryption on managed devices
checks.remediation: Enforce FileVault or BitLocker with an MDM profile and escrow the recovery key.

checks.name: Vulnerabilities fixed within SLA
checks.remediation: Patch or accept the risk for open findings past their severity SLA (critical 15, high 30, medium 90, low 180 days).

checks.name: HRIS leavers have no active accounts
checks.remediation: Suspend every account that belongs to a terminated employee.

checks.name: Security alerts are triaged
checks.remediation: Acknowledge or resolve open alerts and assign an owner.

checks.name: Monitoring alerts are active
checks.remediation: Unmute monitors or document why they are muted.

checks.name: Audit logs retained for one year
checks.remediation: Raise retention on audit indexes to at least 365 days or archive to cold storage.

checks.name: Security training completed
checks.remediation: Send reminders and escalate overdue learners to their managers.

checks.name: Background checks cleared
checks.remediation: Finish or adjudicate the pending screenings before granting production access.

checks.name: Managed databases encrypted and private
checks.remediation: Turn on encryption at rest and remove 0.0.0.0/0 from database access lists.

checks.name: TLS enforced on public domains
checks.remediation: Set SSL mode to Full (strict), turn on Always Use HTTPS and minimum TLS 1.2.

checks.name: Password manager members use MFA
checks.remediation: Require two-factor in the password manager policy for every member.

checks.name: Server backups enabled
checks.remediation: Turn on automated backups for every production server.

checks.name: Firewalls block unrestricted inbound
checks.remediation: Restrict administrative ports to known address ranges.

checks.name: Changes approved before release
checks.remediation: Record an approver on every change before it is released.

checks.name: On-call schedules are staffed
checks.remediation: Fill the gaps in on-call rotations so every hour has a responder.
